main.description: Creates or replaces a team of an organization, with the entries behind its commitments. The caller must be an admin of the organization, or a maintainer of the team. The record counts once the previous record's threshold attests it, or, for a new team, the organization's admins' threshold.

organization.description: The organization, whose handle is a scope on this host.

name.description: One DNS label, under the rules for a profile's 'name'.

entries.description: The entries behind the record's commitments, which the host keeps private.

swapRecord.description: The CID the record must have now; the write fails with 'InvalidSwap' otherwise.

errors.name: InvalidSwap
errors.description: The record's current CID is not 'swapRecord'.
